title: 第330章 你是乌鸦道人第329章 一百亿灵石已经到手
content_zh:
第330章你是乌鸦道人？
嗡！
眼前的天地顿时一变。
大地化作一片灰黄，沿途的花草树木则泛着深浅不一的黄光、绿光，各种颜色交错在一起，顺着山野朝远处铺开。
纯小白就这么开着通宝神眼，一路狂奔。
没跑多远，他突然瞥见前方贴着地面冒出一道三米多高的绿光，仔细看去。
那人弓着腰，探着脑袋，生着一张皱巴巴的鞋拔子脸，正鬼鬼祟祟身影正朝着万花宗摸去。
纯小白当场愣住。
这张脸……
怎么跟上次那个老杂毛一模一样？
“我去，不是在做梦吧？”
纯小白揉了揉眼睛，再次凝神看去。
没错。
就是上次救过他的那个老杂毛！
可那老家伙，不是已经被老妖婆一枪捅死了吗？
难不成是察觉到本大王身陷危机，特意从坟头里爬出来救场？
“不对，不对。”
纯小白很快摇了摇头。
虽然这是修仙世界，可凡事其实也要讲一点科学，一个死得不能再死的人，怎么可能突然复活？
难道是通宝神眼出了问题？

他一边逃，一边揉着眼睛，又悄悄往前凑近了一些。
再看。
还真是那个老杂毛！
至于这老家伙是怎么活过来的，纯小白暂时没工夫细想，他望着那张熟悉的鞋拔子脸，眼睛直放光。
“缘分呐！”
“而且这个老杂毛对于殿后，相当有经验！”
与此同时，乌鸦道人突然察觉到，自己的神识范围内，数十道强横气息正从远处疾驰而来。
“不好，被发现了！”
乌鸦道人心头一跳，猛地趴在地上，收住呼吸，连一根手指都不敢乱动。
仔细感知片刻，乌鸦道人又松出一口气。
那些万花宗强者虽然都在朝这个方向赶，却没有一道神识真正锁定他，说明她们只是恰好往这边搜来，并未发现他的踪迹。
乌鸦道人趴在地上抬手摸着胡须，眉头却越皱越紧。
“奇怪……”
“这群老娘们儿，为何全都朝贫道这边来了？”
啪！
乌鸦道人正琢磨着，一只手突然从背后伸来，搭在了他的肩膀上，吓的他浑身一僵，裤裆一热。
content_en:
Chapter 330 Are you a Crow Taoist?
Buzz!
The world in front of him suddenly changed.
The earth turned into a grayish yellow, and the flowers, plants and trees along the way glowed with different shades of yellow and green light. Various colors were intertwined and spread out into the distance along the mountains and fields.
Chun Xiaobai just opened the Tongbao Divine Eye and ran all the way.
He didn't run far when he suddenly caught a glimpse of a green light over three meters high emerging from the ground in front of him and looked carefully.
The man was hunched over, head tilted out, with a wrinkled shoehorn face, and his figure was sneaking towards the Wanhua Sect.
Chun Xiaobai was stunned on the spot.
This face...
Why is he exactly the same as that old bastard last time?
"I'm going, aren't you dreaming?"
Chun Xiaobai rubbed his eyes and looked attentively again.
That's right.
It's the old bastard who saved him last time!
But wasn't that old guy stabbed to death by the old witch?
Could it be that he sensed that the king was in crisis and crawled out of the grave to save him?
"No, no."
Chun Xiaobai quickly shook his head.
Although this is a world of immortality, everything actually requires a bit of science. How can a person who has died no longer die suddenly be resurrected?
Is there something wrong with Tongbao's divine eye?
As he ran away, he rubbed his eyes and quietly moved closer.
Look again.
He is really that old bastard!
As for how this old guy came back to life, Chun Xiaobai didn't have time to think about it for the time being. He looked at the familiar shoehorn face, his eyes shining brightly.
"Fate!"
"And this old bastard is quite experienced in dealing with the queen!"
At the same time, Taoist Crow suddenly noticed that within the scope of his consciousness, dozens of powerful auras were galloping from a distance.
"No, I was discovered!"
Taoist Crow's heart skipped a beat, and he suddenly fell to the ground, holding his breath and not even daring to move a finger.
After carefully sensing it for a moment, Taoist Crow breathed a sigh of relief.
Although the powerful men of the Ten Thousand Flowers Sect were all rushing in this direction, none of their spiritual senses had really locked onto him, which meant that they just happened to search this way and did not find any trace of him.
Taoist Wu Wu lay on the ground and raised his hand to touch his beard, but his brows became more and more wrinkled.
"Strange..."
"Why are these old ladies all coming towards Pindao?"
Snap!
While Taoist Crow was pondering, a hand suddenly stretched out from behind and put it on his shoulder. He was so frightened that his whole body froze and his crotch felt hot.
